Paragraph: "You speak the truth, Lakshmana; grief must not consume the mind when duty calls us forward..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Acknowledging the necessity of putting duty above emotional suffering.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama verbally validates Lakshmana's counsel and aligns himself with purposeful duty.
Outcome/Resolution: He consciously chooses duty over paralyzing grief.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Kartavya-Bodh (Clear awakening to primary duty above personal pain)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Prioritizing Dharma (duty) over personal sorrow aligns the soul with divine purpose and grants ultimate resilience.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Values-based commitment: choosing purposeful action consistent with core values over avoidance driven by emotional pain.
